modules.module_title: Protect personnel working in vicinity of mineral production faces

pcs.pc_description: oversee end-to-end mining operations and follow the duties of a Mining Mate as mentioned in the regulations by DGMS
check if he finds any person in a place other than the one assigned to him, may communicate the same to that person, and shall forth with report the matter
observe if any inexperienced person is employed on any work except under the supervision of an experienced person and report the same to the superior
report to superior official any deficiency in timber, appliances and other necessaries required for the safe working of the district

take care that any dangerous operation is carried out with due precaution,and in such cases shall be present through out whenever any work of clearing falls of ground and setting of supports there in is being carried out
ensure not to leave the district under his charge until the end of the shift or until relieved by a duly appointed substitute

check if the mine is worked by a continuous succession of shifts,shall, before leaving his district, confer with the sirdar or competent personsucceeding him, and shall acquaint him with all matters requiring personal attention and give such other information as maybe necessary for the safety of his district and of the persons employed there in
monitor, record and control the number of persons in respective area ofresponsibility

observe that staff working within the area of responsibility gets aware if any hazardous situation has occurred and knows the appropriate action to be taken to inform others without jeopardizing the safety of self
carry out checks on the competency of persons employed in mineral extracting
communicate with staff to position them appropriately in order to prevent contact with moving plant/equipment/machine parts
observe the usage of appropriate personal protective equipment
check to ensure personnel are not exposed to excessive work hazards (e.g.vibration, hazardous substances)
observe that manual handling tasks are minimized by the use of mechanical lifting devices.
confirm checks on safety devices have been carried out
identify problems (e.g. obstructions, geological movements, mechanical or service failure)and report to the appropriate person for advice or repair/remedial action
monitor the operational cycle and all relevant operations within area of responsibility/specific district
check if the material needs for the production unit are met using material transport system and report in case of any inconsistencies
co-ordinate face operations to maintain a true line of advance or retreat to prevent excessive face creep.
oversee the immediate advance and setting of support (temporary/permanent) to combat poor roof conditions/face conditions and supervise the application of the support rules
check the dressing of exposed ground
co-ordinate work operations to ensure that each ongoing activity does not affect the activities, health, and safety of others within your sphere of responsibility
complete records/reports according to legislative requirements and organizational procedures

modules.module_title: Oversee inspection and maintenance of mineral production faces and associated equipment

pcs.pc_description: check that all haulage, storage, purification, and distribution work is performed efficiently and in compliance with statutory and other regulations
monitor that all traveling roadways to, and working places in, his district are made and kept secure

check to ensure fire hydrants and/or other firefighting equipment is correctly sited, installed, undamaged, and, fit for purpose in accordance with regulatory requirements and organizational procedures and operational requirements
implement isolation and lock-off procedures for plant/equipment as required for adjustments or routine or forced maintenance
oversee planned maintenance of respirable/combustible dust suppression equipment
confirm that all safety devices fitted to mineral extraction and clearance system/s are in place and operational
confirm that all service pipes, hoses, high tension cables, and trailing cables are identified, color- coded, stored correctly and have appropriate safety devices attached
check that services system (e.g.cable handling devices)are supported, free moving and have sufficient storage to allow safe face advance/retreat
confirm that girder cradles/integrated working platforms associated with setting supports are available and in good order
confirm that support installations/extraction systems/materialshandling/mineral processing machinery/equipment areserviced/maintained in accordance with manufacturers/companyprocedures
check that suitable and sufficient repairs have been carried out safely on damaged/faulty items of mineral extraction equipment
carry out organisational procedures for defects found that cannot be rectified immediately.

pcs.pc_description: check that the blast specification(s) are according to approved procedures and practices
check that the changes to the blast specifications are in line with the defined requirements
make arrangements for the delivery and receipt of sufficient, suitable materials to meet the blast specification.
maintain the adequate security measures for on-site explosives are andensure thatthe records are completed
monitor the timely issue the explosives to relevant person(s) inaccordance to approved practices and procedures
carry out the checks to ensure activities involving the use, transportation and storage of explosives or explosive substances are carried out by relevant person(s)
make the arrangements to ensure environmental controls are set up and monitored to meet local requirements

identify the potential risks and appropriate action taken to eliminate or minimise.

inspect that the checks are carried out to confirm warning and security arrangements are in place and operating according to approved procedures and practices

review the work of the shotfirer to blast at an agreed time is given when operating and environmental conditions are confirmed assuitable according to approved procedures and practices
maintain and store records in accordance with operational and organisational rules and procedures
carry out the post-blast in spection according to approved procedures and practices
ensure the approval of the post-blast remedial work according to operational procedures

on completion of the blasting operation, ensure the removal of warning and security arrangements, and signal that the area is returned to normal operational status, according to approved procedures and practices
monitor and record the over pressure and ensure their conform ancetolocal requirements
monitor the site-specific shot firing rules and procedures and provide the relevant recommendations

follow the manufacturer’s instructions for care and safe operation of mine machinery and equipment
identify the working ventilation district from line diagram of ventilation circuit to direct air to the working face
follow laid out SOP in case of alarm signal for leakage of inflammable gases
follow the process of reporting any unsafe act/condition in the working area to the concerned person
use underground mine communication system
ensure positive isolation near the work place if applicable
use appropriate Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) as per the requirement
maintain hand hygiene by washing hands with alcohol based sanitisers/soap
disinfect the machine/tools before and after work/task
maintain hygiene at the work site
report any symptoms of illness to the shift- incharge
identify six directional hazards at workplace and take decisions accordingly
identify the environmental impact of mining related operations and follow steps to reduce those impact
follow the mineral conservation practices in U/G mining operations to achieve optimum ore or mineral recovery
ensure that the stowing practices produce minimum disturbance to the surface
ensure that the subgrade coal is carried out to surface and stacked separately at the earmarked place
ensure the productivity of the machine for material/fuel conservation
follow the process for collecting, storing and disposing of the hazardous material and waste (like used oil, lubricant, battery, etc.) in compliance with worksite guidelines
follow the "5-S" practice at work site like cleaning oil from ground (to avoid soil from getting damaged), etc.
